title: Three-Layer LLM Evaluation Architecture, Golden Regression Suites, and Paired T-Test Significance Gating
author: Brain Harness Reflector

claims.assertion: Traditional deterministic unit testing fails for non-deterministic LLM applications because variable text generation cannot be asserted via exact equality.
claims.source: freeCodeCamp: 'How to Build a Self-Evaluating AI System' by Jude Otine (2026-09-17)

claims.assertion: A production LLM evaluation pipeline requires three tiered layers: Layer 1 deterministic checks (<1ms, $0 cost, catching ~30% of failures), Layer 2 semantic LLM-as-judge evaluation (anchored 1-5 scales, JSON response, 3-judge median consensus), and Layer 3 human evaluation loops (lightweight JSONL annotation, Cohen's Kappa > 0.6).
claims.source: freeCodeCamp: 'How to Build a Self-Evaluating AI System' by Jude Otine (2026-09-17)

claims.assertion: Model and prompt changes in CI/CD must be evaluated against a golden dataset (50-100 edge-case examples) using paired Student's t-test (p < 0.05) to eliminate random noise and prevent regressions before production deployment.
